title: My Son Sold My $540K Puppet Theater. I Got A $4,200 Ticket. So I Voided The Sale
description: After my son forged a dissolution of our notarized puppet theater partnership, sold my antique marionette collection for $540,000, and mailed me a $4,200 "string" ticket, I retrieved the original contract sewn inside a puppet's coat. I voided the sale and now run Strings of Deceit Puppetry, where he sands limbs under a sign of his own fraud. Every show program prints his federal docket number. #PuppetRevenge #FamilyBetrayal #StringsOfDeceit
thumb_text: HE SENT ME A $4,200 TICKET I VOIDED HIS $540K SALE
pinned_comment: If your son had forged a dissolution of your notarized puppet theater partnership and mailed you a $4,200 "string" ticket instead of a front-row seat, what would you have done? Share your story in the comments.
